title: ATSF4G RPC & Service Observability
description: RED for RPC/traces and process-level utilization. Variables support environment, zone, service type, process instance, RPC system, method, and span kind.

panels.title: Inbound RPC span rate by service
panels.description: SPAN_KIND_SERVER by default; sampled spans, not a guaranteed total RPC count.

panels.title: Trace error ratio by service
panels.description: STATUS_CODE_ERROR rate divided by total RPC rate; business result codes are shown separately.

panels.title: RPC p95 duration
panels.description: p95 duration in milliseconds; buckets are aggregated before quantile.

panels.title: Mean RPC duration
panels.description: Sum of duration sums divided by counts; zero-count groups are excluded.

panels.title: Expected replicas
panels.description: Maximum expected replica recommendation per service.

panels.title: Process CPU usage (per mille)
panels.description: CPU usage in per-mille units; one series per process instance.

panels.title: Process memory
panels.description: Resident set size (RSS) per process instance.

panels.title: Coroutine tasks
panels.description: Current coroutine task count per process instance.

panels.title: RPC method span rate
panels.description: SPAN_KIND_SERVER by default to avoid counting client and server spans as separate RPC calls.

panels.title: RPC p95 duration by method
panels.description: p95 by fully qualified RPC method.

panels.title: Error RPC p95 duration
panels.description: p95 computed only for STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans, separate from successful traffic.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, rpc_system_name AS breakdown_1, COUNT(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM atframework_traces WHERE service_deployment_environment_name IN (${deployment_environment:singlequote}) AND service_service_area_zone_id IN (${zone_id:singlequote}) AND service_name IN (${service_name:singlequote}) AND service_service_instance_id IN (${process:singlequote}) AND rpc_system_name IN (${rpc_system:singlequote}) AND rpc_method IN (${rpc_method:singlequote}) GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: RPC business result codes
panels.description: Distribution only; non-zero business codes are not automatically trace errors.

queries.query: SELECT rpc_system_name, rpc_method, rpc_atrpc_result_code, COUNT(*) AS count FROM atframework_traces WHERE service_deployment_environment_name IN (${deployment_environment:singlequote}) AND service_service_area_zone_id IN (${zone_id:singlequote}) AND service_name IN (${service_name:singlequote}) AND service_service_instance_id IN (${process:singlequote}) AND rpc_system_name IN (${rpc_system:singlequote}) AND rpc_method IN (${rpc_method:singlequote}) GROUP BY rpc_system_name, rpc_method, rpc_atrpc_result_code ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, rpc_method AS breakdown_1, COUNT(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM atframework_traces WHERE service_deployment_environment_name IN (${deployment_environment:singlequote}) AND service_service_area_zone_id IN (${zone_id:singlequote}) AND service_name IN (${service_name:singlequote}) AND service_service_instance_id IN (${process:singlequote}) AND rpc_system_name IN (${rpc_system:singlequote}) AND rpc_method IN (${rpc_method:singlequote}) AND span_status IN ('ERROR') GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Slowest RPC spans
panels.description: Top 50 spans by duration; use trace_id for drill-down.

queries.query: SELECT start_time, trace_id, service_name, service_service_instance_id, rpc_system_name, rpc_method, rpc_atrpc_result_code, span_status, duration FROM atframework_traces WHERE service_deployment_environment_name IN (${deployment_environment:singlequote}) AND service_service_area_zone_id IN (${zone_id:singlequote}) AND service_name IN (${service_name:singlequote}) AND service_service_instance_id IN (${process:singlequote}) AND rpc_system_name IN (${rpc_system:singlequote}) AND rpc_method IN (${rpc_method:singlequote}) ORDER BY duration DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, COUNT(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM atframework_traces WHERE service_deployment_environment_name IN (${deployment_environment:singlequote}) AND service_service_area_zone_id IN (${zone_id:singlequote}) AND service_name IN (${service_name:singlequote}) AND service_service_instance_id IN (${process:singlequote}) AND rpc_system_name IN (${rpc_system:singlequote}) AND rpc_method IN (${rpc_method:singlequote}) GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Stateful index
panels.description: Stateful index per service; expected replicas is available on the Overview tab.
